sentences.text: 夜市開了，店家忙著工作。
sentences.spokenText: 夜市開了店家忙著工作
sentences.imagePrompt: square image / 1:1 composition. Use the approved L058 lesson images only as style references: warm picture-book pencil-and-watercolor linework, soft natural light, detailed but clean environments, expressive preschool proportions, soft cheeks, gentle expressions, bright warm palette, phone-readable square composition. Do not copy any specific person, clothing, hair, face, or body shape from L058. Use protagonist family continuity from L154/L162/L163: protagonist little girl in a pink jacket, white top, blue skirt, pink shoes, and small pink hair clip; protagonist mother in a white or beige top, wide blue pants, and shoulder-length dark hair. Scene: a night market just opening, with warm lights and several plain stalls but no readable signs. A clearly distinct night-market shop owner or shop worker is busy preparing work: arranging plain goods on a stall table, setting out tools, and getting ready to open. Protagonist mother and protagonist little girl stand at a safe edge watching the market become lively. The shop owner or worker must have a different face, hairstyle, clothing color, and body language from protagonist mother and teacher. Center the busy shop worker, stall work, mother, and little girl with safe margins. No readable text, no numbers, no signboards, no price cards, no labels, no logos, no brands, no watermarks.
sentences.imageNotes: 夜市剛開始營業，夜市店家老闆或店員忙著整理攤位、擺放商品或準備開店工作。可有主角小女孩和主角媽媽從安全邊界外看著夜市開始熱鬧，但畫面重點是店家忙著工作。人物身份要明確：夜市店家老闆或店員、主角小女孩、主角媽媽。不可有文字、數字、招牌、價格牌或標籤。

sentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩坐在桌前，專心忙著用紙、顏色材料和安全剪貼工具做一個手作面具。面具可以已經有形狀但不能有文字、數字或標籤。畫面重點是孩子忙著做手作，不要出現恐怖面具。

sentences.text: 工人拿著工具，忙著洗車。
sentences.spokenText: 工人拿著工具忙著洗車
sentences.imagePrompt: square image / 1:1 composition. Use the approved L058 lesson images only as style references: warm picture-book pencil-and-watercolor linework, soft natural light, detailed but clean environments, expressive preschool proportions, gentle expressions, bright warm palette, phone-readable square composition. Do not copy any specific person, clothing, hair, face, or body shape from L058. Scene: a safe car-wash area or home driveway. A clearly identified car-wash worker, visually distinct from protagonist mother and teacher, is busy washing a plain car while holding car-wash tools. Tools include a sponge, bucket, soft brush, or hose. The worker wears practical work clothes or a simple waterproof apron, not teacher clothing and not protagonist-family clothing. Center the car-wash worker, tools, water, and car with safe margins. The car must have no visible license plate text or number. No readable text, no numbers, no signs, no labels, no brands, no logos, no watermarks, no written marks on tools, bucket, clothing, car, or background.
sentences.imageNotes: 洗車場或家門口安全場景，一位洗車工人拿著洗車工具，忙著清洗車子。工具可包含海綿、水桶、刷子或水管，但不可有品牌文字、車牌號碼、招牌或標籤。人物身份要明確：洗車工人。

sentences.text: 手作道具都放回盒子裡。
sentences.spokenText: 手作道具都放回盒子裡

sentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩和老師在活動結束後，把桌上的手作道具放回盒子裡。老師要依 LESSON_VISUAL_CAST_SOP 設計，不能長得像主角媽媽；不要用媽媽的黃色或珊瑚紅配色，不要像家庭場景。畫面重點是手作道具被收進盒子。不可有文字、數字或標籤。

sentences.imageNotes: 家裡門口或室內靠近門邊的地面有雨後帶進來的水，主角媽媽忙著用布或拖把擦地，主角小女孩站在旁邊。主角媽媽要依 L154/L162/L163 主角家庭 reference，不可畫成老師。畫面重點是雨停後媽媽忙著擦地。不可有文字、數字或標籤。
